messages:
sanjay: Quick sync — OKR draft posted in the doc. Need company-level signoff by EOD Friday so we can hand off to marketing and sales.
maya: I'm looking now. Major ask: Should we keep 'Latency cost per 1k tokens' as a level 2 metric or promote to company KPI? Customers keep asking and it drives infra decisions.
alex: +1 to promoting. Ops teams are already making config tradeoffs around batching/quantization that depend on that signal.
rita: Concern: promoting it will require tighter SLOs on Redwood Dedicated latency. Are we prepared to commit to that across regions?
leo: We can commit for core regions (us-west/us-east/eu-west) but APAC will need a phased SLA. Suggest a rollout criterion: 80th pctile latency <= target in core regions for 2 weeks.
jen: For launch criteria, can we add an objective for 'customer-facing docs + migration guide' to the playbook? Sales needs that when we offer Dedicated incentives.
max: +1. Also suggest a gating item: top 5 pilot customers have verified end-to-end perf on their workloads.
sanjay: Good notes. Proposed changes: promote cost/latency metric to company KPI, add phased SLA language, require docs + 5 pilot validations. Anyone object?
rita: No objection, but we should adjust the timeline. Q3 targets look aggressive if we require pilots for all Dedicated slots.
maya: Timeline ask: if we slide one week to give infra time for rollout automation, we can hit pilot signoffs.
alex: I'll add a small ops automation subtask in the plan. ETA to complete: 3 weeks from kick (will add in doc).
finance-bot: FYI: Changing KPI weighting will affect compensation modeling. Please cc finance when finalizing weights.
max: @finance-bot noted. @sanjay we'll need a final pass on targets before sending to the compensation committee.
leo: Small technical note: for the latency KPI, we should specify measurement window and traffic mix. Suggest `window=14d`, `pctl=80`, traffic=prod-read+write 70/30.
jen: I'll draft the migration guide checklist (docs, sample configs, rollback steps) and share by Thursday.
sanjay: Thanks. Action items: alex add ops subtask + ETA, jen draft migration checklist, maya coordinate pilot customers, max loop in finance on weights. I'll update the OKR doc with SLA phrasing and KPI measurement defs.
rita: One more ask — add a fallback policy objective (auto-fallback to smaller model variant) as part of reliability OKR.
alex: Noted. I'll add fallback policy as a deliverable under reliability.
sanjay: Cool. If no objections, I'll push the updated draft at 5pm PT and ping exec for signoff. :thumbsup:
maya: No objections from my side. :thumbsup:
rita: Fine by me.
max: Finance greenlight pending final numbers, but no blocking objections.
sanjay: Great — thanks team. I'll post the updated doc and add a summary thread tomorrow morning for any late feedback.
